Descriptions do the routing. This file is the coverage backstop: every skill and every agent in the catalog appears below, so a prompt with no matching row in `AGENTS.md` still has a discoverable owner. Read this before inventing a workflow.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/algorithms` | Analyze complexity and data-structure choice for a hot path before implementing |
| `/architect` | Architectural design, capacity math, statechart invariants, and ADR before writing code |
| `/blast-radius` | Analyze impact, dependent files, and regression risks before refactoring or changing shared code |
| `/debug` | Reproduce, root-cause, and fix a bug, flake, or red gate |
| `/doctor` | Audit the skill/agent catalog for collisions, dangling refs, and gaps |
| `/fetch` | Fetch a URL and extract readable content with automatic Playwright escalation for JS-rendered pages |
| `/graphify` | Turn any codebase into a queryable knowledge graph with AST parsing, community detection, and interactive viz |
| `/handoff` | Pause safely — write a durable handoff so the next session resumes with full context |
| `/map` | Build a compact symbol map of a repo and orient before any edits (low token cost) |
| `/onboard` | Map an unfamiliar codebase and emit a project-level AGENTS.md |
| `/ozone-mode` | Activate Ozone Mode |
| `/parallel-dev` | Deploy dual-track parallel subagents for simultaneous implementation and independent acceptance testing |
| `/plan` | Turn a goal into an executable plan before any code is written |
| `/product` | Frame work as user value before building — problem, evidence, slice, metric, verdict |
| `/resume` | Resume work from the last handoff without re-deriving anything |
| `/review` | Adversarial review of the current diff against code-health criteria, severity-ranked |
| `/roblox` | Turn a prompt into a complete, non-slop AAA Roblox game via autonomous multi-agent orchestration |
| `/route` | Show which skill and subagent a request would route to, without doing the work |
| `/search` | Resilient multi-tier web search and online documentation discovery |
| `/ship` | Run the full pre-merge gate, then commit through git-master |
| `/ship-check` | Run the pre-ship gate on the current change |
| `/tdd` | Red-Green-Refactor test-driven bug fixing and feature development |
| `/unslop` | Ruthlessly audit diffs or files for AI fluff, redundant comments, dead code, and speculative bloat |
| `/ux-review` | Review the running interface for usability, state coverage, keyboard, motion, and microcopy |
| `/verify` | Prove work with deterministic local evidence (tests, linters, types, benchmarks) |
